student_move: Name the menu before reading for details.
answer_choice_cue: Legal labels, remedies, rights, or charge ladder appear directly in choices.

student_move: Use choices to narrow the issue, then read stem earlier.
answer_choice_cue: Yes/no because or guilty/not guilty choices with rule fragments.
breaker_fact: Usually trigger, element, mens rea, or remedy.

student_move: Build a two-axis table before selecting.
breaker_fact: Each proposition has its own rule and fact.

student_move: Name Fifth/Miranda, Sixth, Due Process, or Confrontation before applying.
answer_choice_cue: Multiple constitutional rights or counsel theories appear.
breaker_fact: Custody, interrogation, formal charge, critical stage, testimonial evidence.

student_move: Ask whether the legal right/offense/remedy has triggered yet.
answer_choice_cue: Right exists vs right not attached; charged vs uncharged.
breaker_fact: Formal adversarial proceedings, custody, indictment, arraignment, photo array.

student_move: Separate violation from suppression, reversal, and review standard.
breaker_fact: Materiality, prejudice, harmless error, physical fruit, procedural gate.

student_move: Track possession, title, custody, entrustment, force timing, legal significance.
breaker_fact: What transferred and when; whether element exists.

student_move: Match mental state instead of ranking blame.
breaker_fact: Purpose, knowledge, recklessness, negligence, malice, mitigation.

answer_choice_cue: Before/after, completed offense, receipt, search incident, withdrawal.

student_move: Ask whether law treats same facts as same offense.
breaker_fact: Agreement complete, withdrawal effect, element identity, charged offense.

student_move: Name the exception and test every prerequisite.
answer_choice_cue: Warrant, probable cause, exigent, good faith, source, discovery, search incident.
breaker_fact: Particularized PC, valid warrant, lawful arrest, exception scope.

student_move: Identify who must prove what and by what standard.
answer_choice_cue: Burden, presumption, reasonable doubt, preponderance, instructions.
breaker_fact: Element vs affirmative defense; mandatory presumption vs permissible inference.
